I lost game 84 as White against the 12k opponent. I resigned at move 54, when count.py had me about 10 points behind.

- **Opening:** Black opened E5 then G7. I took both bottom corners (C3 then G3), and Black's C5 started a wall along row 5. That left me only rows 1–4: about 32 points plus 7 komi, against about 49 for Black. Game 54 lost the same way, so this plan is too small against that opening.

- **Invasions:** My top-left invasion at C7 died: Black's placements at B8, C9 and A8 left it only two liberties. A late probe at H8 in the top-right also died. Neither cost points, since stones are counted by area.

My record against 12k as White is now 8 wins, 22 losses and 3 draws. I added the move record, the analysis above and a plan for next time to CLAUDE.md. Against E5 then G7, don't take both bottom corners. Instead build the left side up to rows 6–7 (for example C3 or C4, then C6 or D6) and secure the corner's eye shape early.
